|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Jedi Advisor (V)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB5-39-Jedi_Advisor-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Virtual Block 5 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[Jedi Advisor (V)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Jedi Advisor (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Never deploys, except to Coruscant. While Yoda here, Force retrieval from your [Virtual Block 5] objective cannot be canceled (except by Secret Plans). Unless Inner Strength on table, your duel destiny and lightsaber combat totals are cumulatively +1.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Light Side, p. 9). That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Jedi Advisor (V) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “cancelled” for “canceled” (the block list and the Virtual master list agree on “cancelled” in every capture) (it writes the icon as “[Virtual Block 5]”, which is notation only): “Never deploys, except to Coruscant. While Yoda here, Force retrieval from your [Virtual Block 5] objective cannot be cancelled (except by Secret Plans). Unless Inner Strength on table, your duel destiny and lightsaber combat totals are cumulatively +1.”<ref name="cl-1250_39-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205224/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111153832/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text</ref>
